fact: Telecom Review Africa says E-Bawaba is a unified e-government portal where citizens can access civil documents, sign contracts digitally, communicate with authorities and register devices such as smartphones.

The CNTE deck says 2,279,086 pupils in public schools and 194,312 in private schools were registered remotely (online) for the 2023/2024 school year, and 236,560 registered remotely for national exams.

The playbook lists online services across citizen, business, transport, education, university, social, civil servant, justice and finance categories, and citizen portal functions including birth acts, driving licence and vehicle data, electronic signature, notifications and complaints.

The playbook presents the citizen portal e-bawaba.tn as the access point to services and to the national citizen register, with sign-in through E-Houwiya used by services of many ministries and bodies.
The U.S. Embassy's USAID project page says an online registration platform for businesses was created and the RNE portal launched, with taxpayer e-services listed as an objective.

The deck says services using the IUC and Mobile ID include fully online school enrolment, the education and citizen service portals, online civil status extracts and an e-contract for vehicle ownership transfer.
